preconditions.description: The number of possible splits (m) and the number of different monster types (n) are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= mi <= n for mi in monster_ids)
preconditions.description: Each monster ID (mi) in the split rules is within the valid range [1, n].
Each split count (li) is a positive integer.
The total number of split rules does not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n lines, one for each monster type.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(smallest, int) and isinstance(largest, int) for smallest, largest in output)
postconditions.description: Each line in the output contains two integers representing the smallest and largest number of diamonds.

postconditions.expression: all(-1 <= smallest <= largest for smallest, largest in output)
postconditions.description: For each monster type, the smallest number of diamonds is less than or equal to the largest number of diamonds.

postconditions.expression: all(largest <= 314000000 or largest == -2 for smallest, largest in output)
postconditions.description: The largest number of diamonds does not exceed 314,000,000 unless it is -2.
